review_scope: Read-only audit of the sealed ten-sequence FP32-versus-Q8 precision grade and its Q4 comparison; no model execution, data modification, or public/CV claim.

independent_bounded_check.command_scope: Python 3.11 metadata/receipt assertions through scripts/limited at 1 CPU, 1.2 GB, 120 seconds; no parquet scan or callback execution.
checks_run: receipt/group row-count arithmetic and ordered ten group IDs
target and official-mask hashes equal the Q4 receipt for every group
actual precision assertions and expected exact ZIP/member hashes
official score values and Q4-versus-Q8 link consistency

results.exposure: Ten exposed valid groups; the two H390 models were fitted on all supplied train and valid groups, so this is an in-sample precision diagnostic.

limitations: The full valid parquet was not hashed; the receipt binds its size/mtime and hashes the selected feature panel plus per-group target and mask arrays.
This result supports a bounded precision comparison only; it is not clean cross-validation, held-out generalization, a public-score estimate, or a full-data model-quality claim.
The earlier R1 package's Q8 label was false: its exact native members were FP32. Its retraction is preserved and the comparison correctly labels those predictions FP32.
